shortDescription: See Claude Code, Codex and OpenRouter usage in one place, with a desktop widget and local history.
description:
Ai UsageNest is a free, open-source desktop monitor by Mikrofab for Claude Code, Codex and OpenRouter usage. View processed tokens, subscription quotas, reset times, project and session history, and estimated API costs.

For real usage data, install and use Claude Code or Codex, or add an OpenRouter API key. Quota access requires an authenticated account. You can explore the app with sample data first. Usage history is kept on this PC, and saved API keys are encrypted by Windows. The app uses local logs and provider connections to show your data.

The interface supports 12 languages and follows the Windows display language by default. Language, light/dark theme and widget options can be changed in Settings. Quotas depend on provider availability; the Claude quota source is experimental. Estimated API cost is not your subscription bill. Ai UsageNest is not affiliated with Anthropic, OpenAI or OpenRouter.
